goal: Create native legacy coverage registry for LEG-001 to LEG-044.
non_goals: Do not implement Android feature behavior.
Do not mark unimplemented entries as verified.
Do not waive P0 or P1 legacy entries.
Do not change existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
acceptance_criteria: Every LEG-001 through LEG-044 inventory item is present in the native coverage registry.
Every P0 and P1 item has a native owner.
Every P0 and P1 item has a planned verification surface.
Missing or partial P0 items are visible as replacement release blockers.
Current status uses only not_started, in_progress, implemented, verified, waived, or blocked.
No unimplemented entry is marked verified.
verification_expectations: Validate the coverage registry includes exactly LEG-001 through LEG-044.
Validate each row has a gate, owner, planned task, status, release gate state, and verification surface.
Validate all statuses are from the allowed status vocabulary.
Validate no P0 item with missing/partial status is hidden as non-blocking.
Validate ADworkflo JSON artifacts with ConvertFrom-Json.
No Android Gradle build is required because this task changes planning/QA artifacts only.
notes: This task creates a living release-gate registry. Later implementation tasks must update the relevant rows as evidence accumulates.
The registry should distinguish current foundation evidence from full replacement readiness.
